description.value: Add your Charisma modifier to initiative rolls. You also don't need advantage on the attack roll to apply Sneak Attack as long as no creature besides your target is within 5 feet of you and your target itself is within 5 feet of you; every other rule for Sneak Attack still applies. Finally, once you make a melee attack against a creature on your turn, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the remainder of the turn.
